final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The cause was in the vendored `slugify`, which deletes any character outside `a-z`, `0-9`, whitespace and hyphen. Since I can't edit `vendor/`, I fixed it in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now decomposes accented characters and strips the accent marks before calling `slugify`.

Letters with no accent decomposition, such as `ß` or `ø`, are still dropped. `src/shop/product-url.js` also uses `slugify`, and I didn't change it. If product URLs have the same accent problem, the same fix would apply there.
